description: This file defines the ArraySerializer class which provides methods to serialize a PSR-7 RequestInterface object to an array and deserialize an array back into a Request object. It facilitates converting request messages to/from array representations, primarily for testing or data exchange purposes.

classes.name: ArraySerializer
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to serialize and deserialize request messages to and from array formats.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes a RequestInterface object into an associative array containing request details.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a Request object from an array representation of a request message, handling deserialization exceptions.

methods.name: getValueFromKey
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an array by key, throwing an exception if the key is missing.
